hothen: pretends to feel unwell: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, one hand rises softly to her temple under the folded white cloth on her forehead, her eyes half close with a weak little frown, then she peeks slyly from one eye, the other hand rests on the rim
keeps pretending in a slow loop: she sighs weakly with half-closed eyes, touches her temple lightly, then peeks slyly from one eye and closes it again; the folded cloth stays on her forehead
chan: grows bored: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, props her cheek lightly on one hand, the other hand lets a half-finished embroidery hoop hang loosely, she rolls her eyes up with a flat mouth

stays bored in a slow loop: she rolls her eyes up, lets out a slow bored sigh, taps the embroidery hoop lightly with one finger, her cheek stays propped on her hand; the hoop stays in her hand, no flying thread
choang: is stunned: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, both hands go limp on the rim, she stares blankly straight ahead with dull eyes and her mouth slightly open, a small faint grey cloud appears above her head
stays stunned in a slow loop: she blinks slowly once, stares blankly straight ahead, her mouth slightly open, both hands limp on the rim, the small grey cloud drifts a little above her head
hon: refuses coldly: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, turns her face a little away with her chin up and eyes closed, lifts one hand small at chest height palm out saying 'no', a cold 'hmph' pout; the other hand rests on the rim

keeps refusing in a slow loop: she gives a small cold 'hmph', lifts her chin a little higher with eyes closed, gives her raised palm a small 'no' shake at chest height; the other hand stays on the rim
khochiu: grows irritated: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, her brows angle down, her mouth tightens into a small frown, she points one finger a little to the side at chest height; the other hand rests on the rim; mouth closed
stays irritated in a slow loop: she taps her pointing finger twice to the side at chest height, narrows her eyes, gives a small annoyed huff with her mouth closed; the other hand stays on the rim
